data.one_liner: Draw horizontal or vertical dashed lines in any Flutter platform.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to easily render horizontal or vertical dashed lines inside Flutter applications. It provides a simple widget configuration for height, width, and axis orientation.
use_when: You need to display a simple dashed or dotted line divider
You want to build custom UI layouts requiring dashed separations
avoid_when: You need complex vector graphics or custom SVG rendering
You require advanced path animations along the dashed line
strengths: Supports both horizontal and vertical orientations
weaknesses: Limited feature set beyond drawing basic lines
Not documented with extensive customization properties
